discovery.title: Mediterranean rockrose extract shows fungicidal activity against common skin infections
discovery.summary: A polyphenol-rich extract from Cistus salviifolius, a Mediterranean rockrose species traditionally used to treat skin conditions, has shown fungicidal activity against several dermatophytes, the fungi responsible for superficial infections of the skin, hair and nails.
